pr_body: Implements the ADR 0121 MCP lifecycle foundation: a loopback-only Streamable HTTP endpoint, ephemeral lifecycle discovery/authentication metadata outside project data, and request routing into the live Editor authoring session. Scene/entity/schema and existing Behavior Tree MCP tools share the live host. Cargo.lock changes only because engine-editor gains direct engine-mcp and getrandom dependencies, so full Windows validation is expected. Visual validation is not required because this change does not alter Editor presentation.
